info.name: Bitrix24 REST BIconnector Message Providers API

items.docs: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The method `messageservice.message.status.update` updates the delivery status of a message sent through a messaging provider. This method works only within the context of an [application](../../settings/app-installation/index.md).

info.name: Register an SMS Provider or Message Provider messageservice.sender.add

items.docs: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The method `messageservice.sender.add` registers a new message provider. This method works only in the context of an [application](../../settings/app-installation/index.md).

info.name: Delete SMS Provider or Message Provider messageservice.sender.delete

items.docs: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The method `messageservice.sender.delete` removes a previously registered message provider for the current application. This method works only within the context of an [application](../../settings/app-installation/index.md).

info.name: Get a List of SMS Providers or Message Providers messageservice.sender.list

items.docs: If you are developing integrations for Bitrix24 using AI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor), connect to the [MCP server](../../ai-tools/mcp.md) so that the assistant can utilize the official REST documentation. The method `messageservice.sender.list` returns a list of provider codes registered with the current application. This method works only in the context of the [application](../../settings/app-installation/index.md).
